description: A balloon payment is the lump sum due when a loan's remaining balance comes due before its monthly payments would pay it off, and this tool computes the monthly payment, the balloon amount and (with a yield) the note's price. Use it for a balloon mortgage or note whose payment is set on a long amortization but whose balance is due early. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

amortization_months.description: Months the payment is calculated over, e.g. 360.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

balloon_month.description: Month the remaining balance is due, counted from now.

payment.description: Actual monthly payment if it differs from the calculated one.

yield.description: Target yield the buyer needs, annual % (monthly compounding).

name: balloon_note
title: Balloon payment calculator
